brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.requirement: Base with removable bins for small parts
requirements.evidence: Two adjacent full hex bases (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) each fitted with removable divided bins (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2) – 2-compartment full-depth trays suitable for small electronics parts, dropped into cells without fixings.
One notch drawer frame (notch:0#0,1#notch1 – hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm) installed in the notch between the two bases at 0,1,0 – provides a pull-out drawer for the organizer.
Carry handle fitted on top cover (handle:0,0,0;top on cover:0,0,0;full;top with inserts) – enables portable carry; second cover on adjacent cell completes the base top surface.

finish.summary: Portable 2-cell organizer built: two full bases with top covers, two divided removable bins (2-compartment) for small parts, one notch drawer frame between cells, and a top-mounted carry handle. check_build ok, meshClash clear, portable footprint.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
